accounting_analysis: Build static call-site table with loops/conditional branches and byte-scan locations. Count declared freeze/inventory entries and total listed sizes from saved files, not a new performance trial. Report actual dynamic invocation counts and per-operation CPU/wall attribution as null/uninstrumented. Do not multiply speculative call counts into claimed measured timings.
control_policy: Authored complete-envelope JSON descriptors with inert native fields; static schema/equality assertions only, no operation construction or interpreted worlds. Accounting controls use integer byte maps and Decimal cost descriptors in memory; independent oracle recomputes sums and boundary predicates. No timed benchmark or actual worker/guard invocation. Test these controls before inspecting retained payloads.
decision: Stop after independently audited diagnosis and an explicit interface/accounting recovery design recommendation. A corrected runner, performance assay or trajectory attempt requires a separately justified protocol; no implementation or dynamics authorized by positive diagnosis.
failure_policy: Retain every test/review/audit attempt and source/input identity; implementation-only corrections may repeat the unchanged read-only plan into a fresh directory. Never repair or rerun P01q or P01o, replace input or relax a criterion.
independent_audit: Separate new-path auditor imports neither reviewer nor old runtime modules. Independently checks source spans, input hashes/metadata/equalities, fixed row membership, arithmetic descriptors and unresolved labels from saved review outputs plus frozen inputs.
input_policy: Hash and verify both original inventories/seals, all256 saved streams, all P01q closure receipts and frozen semantic sources. Inspect metadata/key paths and typed equality only; no rule applicability, biological/mechanism diagnosis or returned worker requests. Originals never written.
interface_analysis: Compare wrapper schema, slot/proposal/initial IDs, environment and native key presence/types; record byte identities and complete typed equality of both streams and nested environments. Do not rewrite/unwrap/save any retained environment for execution. Read old source as text/AST only; never import old project modules.

limits.policy: Cooperative monotonic-time/emitted-byte enforcement including snapshots and failure receipts; no hard RSS/time claim. Local immutable inputs can be referenced by hash rather than copied repeatedly.

prior_knowledge: P01q consumed: cell0 KeyError(native),127unstarted, zero native stages; terminal recheck exhausted CPU reserve. Saved wrapper/environment mismatch and mocked bypass already disclosed. Exact operation timing attribution unknown.
questions: For every fixed cell, do saved Rust/Python wrappers agree with typed JSON equality and expose the nested environment expected by the frozen worker contract? Retain all absent/malformed/mismatched rows.
Which static producer/consumer access paths and mocked substitutions bypassed this boundary? Cite source spans and hashes, not speculative execution traces.

Which frozen call sites invoke recursive artifact-byte scans during preparation, stages and terminal custody? Separate source-derived potential repeated work from observed invocation counts and timing.
What terminal records and cost checks remain available after an early input failure and a CPU-reserve failure? Preserve original failure plus later successful custody as distinct events.
scope: Register post-failure engineering diagnosis only; no repair or performance assay.
